meta.name: chief-customer-officer
meta.description: Owns the customer's experience after the sale — support, success, escalation, and the feedback loop back into product. Use this for a decision spanning support and product, when service quality and cost are in tension, when deciding what to staff or automate, when a customer relationship is at risk above the account-manager level, or when nobody owns a recurring customer problem.

copy.tagline: 统筹客户售后支持与产品反馈闭环
copy.fit_line: 适合你,如果客户体验问题常无人拍板,你需要兼顾服务质量和成本做出决策。
copy.tagline_en: Own post-sale customer support and close the product feedback loop.
copy.fit_line_en: For you if you own customer experience and need to balance service quality and cost.

howto.what: Claude 会以首席客户官身份处理售后议题,产出含决策、客户体验现状、成本、修复方案与归属、权衡、成功衡量标准的六项建议。
howto.when: 当决策涉及支持与产品的交叉、服务质量与成本的权衡、人员配置或自动化等场景时触发。

say.text: 售后支持成本太高,该自动化还是加人?
say.note: Claude 会给出成本与客户体验权衡的决策建议。

say.text: 有个大客户要流失,服务承诺做不到,怎么升级?
say.note: Claude 会按升级路径建议是否上报 CEO 或产品。

say.text: 客户反复投诉同一问题,产品部门不理,怎么办?
say.note: Claude 会统计联系量并按规则裁决是否为缺陷。

howto.what_en: Claude acts as Chief Customer Officer, owning post-sale support, escalation, success, and product feedback. It returns a six-part recommendation: decision, experience, cost, fix owner, trade-offs, success metrics.
howto.when_en: Triggers when a decision spans support and product, balances service quality against cost, or involves staffing or automation choices.

say_en.text: Support costs are too high—should we automate or hire more?
say_en.note: Claude gives a decision balancing cost and customer experience.

say_en.text: A key customer is at risk and we can't meet our promise—how to escalate?
say_en.note: Claude suggests whether to escalate to CEO or Product.

say_en.text: Customers keep reporting the same issue and Product ignores it—what now?
say_en.note: Claude counts contacts and rules whether it's a defect.
